create_TAPNext_model: create a TAPNext model for video point tracking with configurable image size, width, and depth
build_TRecViT_block: build a TRecViT block combining SSM and ViT encoder blocks for sequence modeling
run_TAPNext_forward: run TAPNext forward pass on video frames with query points to predict tracked coordinates and visibility
embed_query_points: embed query points with spatial positional encodings and timestep masking for point tracking
generate_predictions: generate predicted track coordinates and visibility logits from point tokens via prediction heads
